work_order.objective: Separate source conditions, source advice, suspected modifiers, and unknown success conditions before any definition is chosen.

acceptance_checks: The audit passes its schema and semantic inspector.
Unknown success conditions remain explicitly unknown.
Before acceptance, the deterministic full-fingerprint check reports UNCHANGED; every difference remains a visible proposal and the baseline stays effective.
work_order.stop_condition: Stop when the concept audit is complete or a missing source fact makes it blocked.
